settings.subtitle: System state and data sources
settings.modelsHelp: Every sign records the model version that classified it, so changing models does not rewrite past results.
settings.dataHelp: These come from the runtime environment and are not editable here.
settings.limitsBody: Classification currently runs CLIP zero-shot with no training and is frequently wrong on regulatory signs. The review queue exists to collect the labels that replace it. Access requires an account, but every signed-in user sees every survey; per-organisation separation is not implemented.
